bio: A wine bar with strong ties to its city, this buvette is a place where people come for a pick-me-up: an intimate atmosphere, inviting decor, copper-clad bar, and a soundtrack of vinyl playing in the background. The inventive cuisine comes as small plates to share; choose about four. The menu, which changes daily, comprises classics such as cured duck or locally caught wild sea bass, cooked to perfection and served with roasted sweet peppers and turnips, bound together by the sweetness of a soft pear and a spicy ginger vinaigrette. There is a fine selection of wines, some produced locally and all at wallet-friendly prices....
